verdict.rationale: Navan documents policy and approval workflows ("unlimited policy and approval workflows"), policy limits on hotel bookings, and flag/decline reasons with approver routing. Together these show some spend-control enforcement. However, nothing in the evidence shows allocating budgets to teams or projects, or card limits tied to those budgets. Card management evidence covers only active/inactive status and card details. Missing for 10: budget allocation to teams/projects, card spending limits tied to budgets, evidence that approvals and declines enforce budget caps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
